design: Fit8D PCA span on raw uncentered training activations; learn orthogonal rotation minimizing smooth absolute coordinate magnitude(sqrt(z²+1e-6)), choose by validation sparsity. Infer4groups from most frequent top3atom supports among training examples with <=1%energy outside top3. No generating labels in fitting or group selection. Exact16pattern gate inference at0.01primarycost and1e-5sensitivity. Random orthogonal rotation controls for each seed.
limitations: Known8atoms/4groups/3members, orthonormal dictionary assumption, noiseless synthetic teacher, exact inference exponential, repeated exploratory benchmark. Staged unsupervised conditional on these structural priors, not LLM validation.
